programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Conservation Society are up in arms, when a recent new build, called Swanscombe House is a highlight of an open garden day. It leads to an ugly confrontation between a couple of its members and those responsible for the planning application, design and build. The people of which are suspected of involvement in a money-making scam. Political squabbles, burglaries and sexual liaisons all come to the fore in picturesque Great Pelfe.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A spa weekend at Swavely Manor, proves far from relaxing, when Tom and Joyce Barnaby arrive. It starts stressful and goes rather downhill when a female client is found dead in the flotation chamber, by Joyce. Barnaby takes a break from his treatment to investigate alongside Jones. The mystery deepens when the woman's husband disappears in the night shortly afterwards. Tom's worries about his future seem to distract him from the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As preparations are underway for Cully Barnaby's wedding, Ned Fitzroy and Beth Porteous are married in Bledlow village. At the gorgeous reception at Bledlow Hall, the maid of honour, Marina Fellowes, is found by a couple of guests murdered in an upstairs room. With the honeymoon postponed, the newlyweds and their guests find themselves being interrogated by the police.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the name of Tommy Hicks, who was executed for cowardice and desertion during World War I, is added to the war memorial in Midsomer Parva, the Hicks family are very glad. The son and grandson, Lionel and Mayor Dave Hicks, revel in the occasion. The Hammond family are much more displeased. Henry, the patriarch, is infuriated by the move, having sustained a long-running feud with the Hickses.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Early on in the case, they learn that their son Michael had been killed in a hit and run. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. DCI Barnaby begins his investigations when it is found that one skeleton had modern dental work. Meanwhile, DS Troy, having been promoted to Inspector has his last case in Midsomer, to look into the murder of a youth, Simon Mayfield (Henry Cavill), who had caused problems for many in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. He is instantly involved in his first case, a woman stabbed after attending a Spanish-themed evening in Midsomer Mallow. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. It quickly becomes clear that the two victims knew a secret about one of the villagers. Are both crimes connected?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. In present day, Roger's son Gareth is killed with the spear, after having altercations with several villagers. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. But it is discovered that he had had his neck expertly broken before his tumble down the stairs. The village's 12th annual Literary festival brings feuding writers, publishers, and editors to town. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village pub of Midsomer Worthy, The Maid in Splendour, is the workplace of many locals. One night, popular barman Jamie Cruickshank is found dead near an abandoned cottage in the woods. The new manager Stephen Bannerman, who is thoroughly disliked by many, wants to sell the Maid to property developers in secret. When Stephen is murdered, Barnaby and Scott have to find out whether Jamie or Stephen was the intended target of the first murder.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Midsomer Parva have all come out one evening to see the revival of an old Pagan festival. The centrepiece is a straw effigy of a woman. When it is set alight and people look on in wonder, it soon turns to horror when the local curate screams out in pain from within the effigy. The villagers quickly turn against Liz Francis, a local teacher who had organised the event.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: Vikings
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

programme.title: Pray For Death
programme.desc: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue
programme.desc: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Cyborg
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Hart's War
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

programme.title: The Devil's Brigade
programme.desc: They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.

programme.title: Force 10 From Navarone
programme.desc: From director Guy Hamilton comes this action-packed WWII adventure! Screen legends Robert Shaw and Harrison Ford star as fearless commandos on a deadly mission to strike a crippling blow against Hitler's army during the darkest days of World War II.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Death Wish II
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

programme.title: Death Wish 3
programme.desc: A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

programme.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programme.desc: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Cannon For Cordoba
programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Indian Fighter
programme.desc: Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

programme.title: Adios, Sabata
programme.desc: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata
programme.desc: The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow
programme.desc: Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
programme.desc: James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: Man With The Gun

programme.desc: 12-year-old Barney has a plan to ensure he gets that bike he wanted for Christmas. To do this he needs to get his hands on the hottest toy in town, a Crabby Mousie Doll. But plans change when he has to save his favourite toy store from a big box CEO.

programme.title: Hot Chocolate Holiday
programme.desc: Colette runs a coffee shop that is home to her secret and famous hot chocolate recipe. She finds herself in competition with Marcus, the kind, new dessert shop owner who draws her customers away with his own specialty hot chocolate. Colette thinks he stole her recipe but she gives him a chance when his store suffers damage from a fire and has to close. Colette works together with him to repair his shop but it might not be enough to get him back on his feet in time for Christmas. It will, however, help Colette see Marcus in a different light, especially as she learns the source of his hot chocolate recipe. Love, hot chocolate and an unexpected connection will bring Marcus and Colette together for the holidays.

programme.title: Christmas At The Holly Hotel
programme.desc: Kathy, a food critic in New York City, returns home for Christmas at the request of her parents. There she meets a handsome police officer, which now complicates her situation.

programme.desc: When she visits her childhood home, sparks fly between a famous model and a farmer with a young daughter. The town is in danger of losing their beloved Santaland festival, but miracles can happen with a little love, family, and faith.

programme.desc: Juliet pitches Christmas candles to her boss to earn a promotion and enlists the help of Tom, a candle store owner. He refuses at first but agrees when he realizes the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

programme.desc: A wreathmaker slips on ice and injures her arm which puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy until a selfless neighbor steps up to keep her business afloat.

programme.title: Matchmaker Christmas
programme.desc: As the Christmas party for a book publishing company approaches, editor Maggie volunteers to help her boss Amanda find a date. Matchmaking is a bit of a hobby for Maggie, but she is thrown off her game when Jaxson, her boyfriend from her college years, shows up at her work—as a newly signed, successful author. Maggie would love to deny she feels anything for him still, but Jaxson isn’t making it easy. She’ll have to face her decisions of the past, along with Amanda eyeing Jaxson, to bring together the perfect matches at Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas with a Prince
programme.desc: Pediatric specialist Tasha Miller is caring for two young patients plus one sinfully gorgeous royal. She knew Prince Alexander at boarding school long ago and thinks he's still a self-absorbed, incorrigible heartbreaker. But when Tasha sees him with the children, his kindness and caring nature shine through so brightly that Dr. Tasha can't help but be attracted.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Tail
programme.desc: This Christmas, Riley Harper fights to save her small-town animal rescue from closing. Across the ocean, Prince Edward of Arendale travels to America to secure a land deal—unaware the property belongs to Riley. When fate (and a lost dog tag) brings them together, sparks fly. But when Riley learns Edward’s true identity, her trust shatters. On Christmas Eve, Edward risks it all to save her shelter—and her heart.

programme.title: A Christmas to Remember
programme.desc: As Christmas dinner preparations unravel, Lauren welcomes friends Megan, Paige, and lonely coworker Nora into her home. Through heartfelt stories of life-changing Christmases, they rediscover the power of kindness, authenticity, forgiveness, and chosen family. As her husband Tom finally arrives and dinner is served, Lauren realizes that the greatest holiday gifts aren't found under the tree, but in love, friendship, and second chances.

programme.title: The Christmas Brew
programme.desc: Overworked Tori is tasked with convincing a small-town brewery to sell to her employers, BEVCO, just before Christmas. However, she’s met with resistance from Evan, the charming brewmaster and owner, who rejects the offer. Stuck at his family’s bed and breakfast until she can persuade them, Tori discovers that the brewery’s true value lies beyond its beer, teaching her that some things are worth more than money.

programme.title: A Christmas Post
programme.desc: Noah Harrington is hired to revitalize a reluctant small town. When he finds undelivered Santa letters from the 1990s, he teams up with local historian Tessa Findlay to track down the long-lost gifts and bring early Christmas joy. As sparks fly between them, Noah hides one letter—Tessa’s childhood wish to ring the town’s Christmas bell before the post office is demolished. Can he save the bell, his job, and their budding romance in time?

programme.title: Christmas Keepsake
programme.desc: Single father, Tom and his daughter, Grace make the big move from the sunny land of Australia to the quaint US town of Ashbury Grove. While exploring her new backyard, Grace finds a mysterious time capsule, containing a guide to a perfect family Christmas. The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince
programme.desc: Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

programme.title: Jingle Belle
programme.desc: Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

programme.title: Sharing Christmas
programme.desc: A real estate developer gets the chance of a lifetime to transform an old shopping complex into a luxury hotspot. But his plans hit a snag when the last holdout is the charming owner of a year-round Christmas shop—someone he unexpectedly connected with just days earlier. As he tries to win her over professionally, he finds himself falling for her and questioning everything he thought he wanted.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince

programme.title: A Merry Single Christmas
programme.desc: Morgan has lost her Christmas spirit after breaking up with her long time boyfriend, Liam. She decides to go to a retreat called The Christmas Lonely Hearts Club where she hopes to rekindle her Christmas spirit. Things seem to be going well until her Ex shows up. Morgan and Liam will have to conceal their previous relationship while trying to discover what it means to be single. What they don’t realize is that adhering to the “no romance” policy might require a Christmas miracle.

programme.title: Christmas on Repeat
programme.desc: An ad executive, overwhelmed by work, is granted a magical do-over of the holidays by Santa. As she relives the same festive days, she begins to recognize how much time she’s missed with her family. Through the repeating moments, she learns to slow down, cherish loved ones, and find balance between career and personal life. The story highlights the importance of connection, presence, and appreciating the people who matter most.

programme.title: A Christmas Cruise
programme.desc: A single, successful writer decides to do double duty when her best friend invites her on a Christmas Cruise and decides to see if finding true love during the holidays can really happen or will it be just another holiday story.

programme.title: My Best Friends Christmas
programme.desc: When Ashley Seever returns home for the holidays hoping to reconnect with her high school sweetheart Grant, she soon meets his new girlfriend. In an attempt to escape the embarrassment, she and her best friend Liam fake their own holiday romance…but when her fake feelings for Liam start to turn real, Ashley will have to choose what her heart really wants this Christmas.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays
programme.desc: When egotistical social media influencer DD Ward's dog is shockingly kidnapped, her long-suffering and under-appreciated assistant Emily forms an alliance with a down to earth local veterinarian to find the puppy before Christmas. As the two investigate all possible suspects, the duo form an unbreakable relationship that just might lead them to become more than partners as they find their own puppy love.

programme.title: The Search for Secret Santa
programme.desc: Cub reporter Sophia thinks she's found a Christmas story that will save her career when she discovers a long-lost, undelivered Secret Santa gift. Trying to uncover and bring closure to the overdue present before Christmas, Sophia discovers much more than she could have hoped for when she discovers that the gift is not only priceless but stolen.

programme.title: The Case of the Christmas Diamond
programme.desc: When New York City lawyer Julia Crawley returns to her Rocky Mountain hometown and her family’s lovely inn for the holidays, she finds herself at the center of a generations-old feud with the family that runs the town’s other inn. As the ongoing competition between the two inns escalates, “forbidden” romance blossoms between Julia and Roger Mason, whose family runs the inn that is her family’s big competitor.

programme.title: The Tree That Saved Christmas
programme.desc: Struggling writer Annie Logan is devasted to learn that she won't be able to go home to the family tree farm in time for Christmas due to the demands of her high-powered boss. But when the tree farm is threatened with closure, Annie bids her life in New York goodbye and rushes home to save the place she has always called home.

programme.title: Broadcasting Christmas
programme.desc: When Veronika Daniels's co-host leaves "Rise and Shine," she opens auditions for replacements, including Charlie Fisher, a seasoned NY newscaster, and Emily Morgan, a spirited human interest reporter. Emily's unexpected viral plea for the job intensifies the competition. As they vie for the role leading up to the Christmas Day Telethon, old romantic feelings between Charlie and Emily resurface, adding a new layer of complexity to their professional rivalry.

programme.title: A Very Charming Christmas Town
programme.desc: When lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang visits the Danish-settled Californian village of Solvang for her big holiday piece, she at first believes the town is simply a tourist trap. But when Aubrey meets handsome community coordinator and chocolate shop owner Sawyer, to show her around town, Aubrey soon starts to fall for him and realizes the magic of Solvang's Christmas spirit shines year round.

programme.title: Lonestar Christmas
programme.desc: When single mom Erin brings her two young daughters to her estranged father’s Texas ranch for Christmas, old wounds resurface. Amid wide-open skies and holiday traditions, she meets charming local restaurateur Mateo. As sparks fly, Erin begins to heal her fractured relationship with her dad and discovers that forgiveness—and unexpected love—may be the greatest gifts waiting under the tree.

programme.title: A Country Music Christmas
programme.desc: Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. While dazzling her with dreams of stardom, Chance—secretly in love with Brooke—spirals. When Brooke discovers he once hid another big offer from her, she’s furious. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

programme.title: Christmas at the Amish Bakery
programme.desc: After leaving her Amish community in her youth, a New York book editor finds herself in desperate need of a new cookbook to save her job. In the process, Brooke gets to upstage the sister who just announced her engagement to Brooke's ex-boyfriend during the holidays. But, with their “marriage” in question, will Brooke and Roger find a spark they didn’t know existed?

programme.desc: Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

programme.title: Christmas Together
programme.desc: After Ava’s workaholic boyfriend cancels their vacation over the holidays, she leave New York City for California for some time to think. After arriving in California, Ava realizes the situation and offers to pack up and leave, but both they convince her to stay and enjoy the holidays together.

programme.title: The Christmas Listing
programme.desc: Julia Rogers, an uptight, hardworking realty owner who’s lost her Christmas spirit, must spend five days at a festive Christmas Inn with her business rival, Chad Everest, to secure the coveted Erickson Farmstead listing. As their competition heats up, unexpected sparks fly, and Julia and Chad discover they share more in common than rivalry, finding that friendship—and maybe even love—can bloom amid holiday cheer.

programme.title: A Christmas Vintage
programme.desc: Samantha goes home to her family winery for the holidays after discovering that her family is in trouble. She will have to believe her inner talent of winemaking while trying to woo and date the unpleasant owner of a competing winery, Parker Williams.

programme.title: Christmas Matchmakers

programme.title: A Date by Christmas Eve

But when her plans go awry and Fisher, the kindly neighbor who has always carried a torch for Chelsea, is magically added to the naughty list by mistake, Chelsea must race against time to set things right before Christmas Eve.

The case quickly dead-ends, but the detective can't quit until he's tried every tool in his investigative arsenal - including forensic psychic Sally Headding. A New Jersey mother wins custody of her three children only to have her ex-husband abduct them and flee. With the help of a detective and psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, she tracks them across the country, but the ex-husband is always one step ahead - putting Nancy's visions to the test.

programme.title: Sir Spooks
programme.desc: Analysis and presentations of scary videos featuring ghosts, creatures and other mysterious subjects.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: Enter a world where craftsmanship meets art at a microscopic level. For the first time ever, high-definition cameras equipped with super-macro lenses reveal the inner workings of some of the most delicate and exquisite timepieces ever created. Two-thousand-year-old-bones may be evidence, never before seen, of an actual crucifixion from the time of Jesus. They may reveal that the classic depiction of Jesus on the cross is not how crucifixions were actually carried out in the 1st Century.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: A recently discovered Dead Sea Scrolls fragment may be the oldest reference to Jesus ever found. It may have been written in Aramaic by some of his earliest disciples. Outside the ancient city of Jericho there is evidence that the same Roman Army that oppressed Christians may have been secretly worshipping Jesus.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: The eruption of Vesuvius may have been the catalyst for the spread of Christianity in the Roman Empire. Have archeologists found the earliest reference to "Christians" in Pompeii? How did our current alphabet evolve? Perhaps from adaptations of Egyptian hierogylphics? How did the symbols become associated with sounds? Travel from Toronto to Serabit El Kadim in Egypt as we look for answers to how we got to our 26 letter alphabet.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: There are literally hundreds of food references in the Bible, but the Bible lists ingredients - not recipes. Learn how to make olive oil as they did in ancient times and find out more about the meat, grains and beans eaten in biblical times and how they were prepared. There is new evidence to suggest that the cross was used as a symbol of Christianity far earlier than the time of Constantine. Excavations in Herculaneum and Bethsaida tell a new story about the adoption of the cross as a representation of faith.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Bible: Unlocked
programme.desc: Around 733 B.C., ten of the twelve tribes of Israel were conquered and exiled by the Assyrian Empire. Where did the Gadarenes of Gadara go when they were exiled? Can we trace them through to the 21st Century in Europe? Is there any archeological proof for the tradition that Christ carried his cross and stopped in certain locations on the way to Calvary? We follow The Stations Of The Cross to find out what traces may remain in present-day Jerusalem.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.desc: In the deserts of Arizona, beneath the vast expanse of the night sky, unseen forces linger, defying explanation and challenging our perception of reality. The psychic describes a desperate struggle unlike anything the boy's parents ever imagined-and tells them their son's life hangs in the balance.

Dr Andrew has a wee problem being understood, but the soon-to-be-Aussie has bigger issues with a young footballer showing signs of spinal and internal injuries after a hard tackle.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Nurse Ebony and Dr Jonathan are on high alert as their patient could turn on them without warning. Dr Mya and Dr David treat a young woman with a broken jaw who is at risk of choking after falling face-first off, her horse and is in a world of pain. Dr Luke and Dr Emma are grateful for a good early sign from a motorbike rider who collided with a car, but alarms soon ring out. Dr Tessa is astounded by a bush remedy used when a farm worker on a forklift fell in high winds, cracking his head.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Every second counts as Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin’s critically injured patient clings to life after a one-tonne camper trailer rolled over him. A confused motorbike rider remembers nothing and feels no pain while Dr Michael searches for chest, spinal and brain injuries. Pregnant Dr Jana needs a covid-free room to drink water, then is back to re-set an artist’s broken wrists.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Dr Sarah must numb a nursing student’s hand to clean her mangled fingers, but the woman won’t let her because she’s terrified of needles. Dr Ali suspects a former war correspondent has serious spinal injuries after the man rolled his car. First-time dads Dr Michael and Dr Luke swap nappy tales before it’s all hands on deck for a motorcycle rider with multiple fractures. Dr Emma and Nurse Emma fear a stoic 79-year-old grandmother might lose her leg after she was hit by a car crossing the street.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients pour through the doors. Dr Jason searches a teen’s mud-encrusted body for breaks after the dirt-bike rider crashed in a race. Nurse Elle and Dr Steve suspect a cyclist with a badly broken leg is being far too brave, masking other injuries. Dr Mya and Dr Matt fear a young tradie could have a life-altering spinal injury after a fall at work. Dr Michelle puts lunch on hold as she and Dr Jonathan examine a 67-year-old motorbike rider for broken bones.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Australia’s ambulance crews are there for everyday people having their worst days. Natalie and Leonard comfort a schoolboy who’s fallen metres out of a tree on his head. MICA paramedic Cam fights to save a much-loved dad in cardiac arrest. Matt and the flight crew race to a fellow paramedic who’s been bitten by a deadly brown snake, but reaching the isolated patient is almost impossible. Mike and Eamon support a young woman with a debilitating yet all-too-common condition.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Everyday thousands of calls come through to Victoria’s ambulance service from desperate people. Nat and Leonard head to a hotel roof-top pool, where a romantic escape in the city ends in disaster for a young mum. Eamon and Mike race to a traumatised child attacked by a dog. Steve and Emily grow increasingly worried about an elderly nun who could be having a stroke. Flight paramedic Matt dashes to the high country as an off-duty firefighter’s life hangs in the balance after a motorbike crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Two million calls for help are made in Victoria every year. In rugged bushland, a dad with his two kids on board has crashed one hundred metres down a ravine. Getting the injured driver out is a nightmare and the teetering wreck could crush the rescuers. Mike and Eamon fear the worst as they rush to a teenager who has plummeted through a skylight, and can Emily and Steve save an elderly man who is on the brink of a cardiac arrest?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A call is made every twelve seconds, from people across Victoria desperate for help. MICA Paramedic Cullen races to a young woman slipping into a potentially fatal diabetic coma. She’s so sick, any treatment Cullen gives could make things worse. A little girl’s terrifying seizure has Glenice on high alert. It’s the 8-year-old’s first attack and she’s unresponsive. Marlie and Tanie treat a skateboard rider who’s crashed at high speed without a helmet. Mike and Eamon reach a fun career milestone.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every twelve seconds across Victoria, a call for help is made to emergency services. Simon and Michaela perform a high-risk intervention on a brain tumour patient having seizures. Cullen races to a man trapped in a wrecked car after an horrific crash. Nat and Leonard help a ninety-one-year-old woman who fell hard while helping a neighbour. Alarm bells ring for Emily and Steve as a man with chest pain worsens dramatically. A young stabbing victim has Tanie and Marlie on high alert.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: On the frontline, paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. Cullen faces every parent’s nightmare as a six-year-old child is hit by a car. Simon and Michaela battle to help a man whose pacemaker is misfiring, sending agonising shocks through his system. Tanie and Marlie fear for their safety as a patient suddenly turns violent. A food delivery rider comes close to disaster and an emergency airlift for a thrill-seeker motorcycle mum who’s catapulted off a cliff.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 38-year-old man has suffered a massive attack while enjoying a day off with his wife in their spa. Cullen fears he could die before they get him to hospital. A teen footballer has collapsed after a bruising tackle and could have a serious head injury. Eamon and Mike’s charm offensive might not work with feisty 94-year-old Miffy. A man has collapsed in a supermarket and a language barrier makes Steve and Emily’s job even harder.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: A 76-year-old motorbike rider suffers catastrophic injuries after a terrifying crash into trees. Veterans Al and Cam race to a lung cancer survivor gasping for air. Emily and Steve help an entertaining patient with mystery arm pain. Mike joins the ‘fun’ ambulance to help seriously ill children escape from their daily challenges. Glenice and Doddsy are called to a bizarre accident, and a heavily bleeding cyclist is enrolled in the Marlie school of safety.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock fighting to save lives. A do-it-yourself loving handyman gets himself into trouble when he tumbles off a three-metre ladder. With no memory, the brave patient may have a brain bleed. Steve and Emily are ready for anything as an office worker is hot and dizzy, and down to his undies. Babysitting duties turn into a nightmare for a terrified grandmother. Eamon is unimpressed with Mike’s fashion sense, and a former grave digger laughs in the face of death.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Exclusive cameras capture the extraordinary work of emergency service heroes. Steve races to remote bushland where a huge tree has fallen and crushed a man’s leg. Cullen takes drastic action to save a patient whose body is shutting down. Cam and Al bend the rules to lift the spirits of a nine-year-old boy after a frightening asthma attack. Homesick Emily ‘adopts’ a Nanna for the day, when she and Steve help a much-loved grandmother and a terrified daughter watches her Mum fight for life.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedic Steve is forced to deploy a high-risk procedure to save a man whose heart is beating out of control. With his distressed family watching on, there are no guarantees the drastic treatment will work. Flight paramedic Ray fears the worst when a young woman crashes through her car’s rear window and smashes onto the road. It’s party time ahead of Leonard’s last shift with his great friend Nat but they will be confronted with one last challenge before an emotional goodbye.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Paramedics work around the clock, fighting to save lives. A terrifying home invasion shocks Mike and Eamon. Despite his own terrible injuries, the victim is desperately worried about his elderly mother. Taz and Amanda take care of a seriously ill little girl whose every day of survival is a miracle. Flight paramedic Ray struggles to understand a bizarre chain of events that began with a stranger knocking at the door in the middle of the night and ended in a house fire.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital, trauma patients arrive around the clock for urgent care. Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson fear for a pregnant woman injured in a high-speed traffic accident. Doctors Andrew Wallace and Jana Alexander urgently treat a jockey who was crushed under a horse. Doctor Jason Gabriel-Anyassor’s patient is in agony after crashing into a truck. Dr Martin Dutch and Nurse Sarah Thomas resort to translator apps to communicate with a scared young tourist hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s Manic Monday at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as trauma patients pour in. Dr George Plunkett and Nurse Sarah Thomas worry a motorbike rider could lose his leg. Doctor Glenn Harrison fears a tradie, crushed under 300 kilos of cement, has brain injuries. Drs Emma West and Mya Cubitt celebrate Dr Jana Alexander’s return from maternity leave with cake, then Dr Mya and Dr Jana diagnose a ‘healthy’ man with a ticking time bomb. Dr Emma investigates a pregnant woman’s chest and leg pains.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Lives hang in the balance at the Royal Melbourne Hospital. Dr Mark Putland and the Trauma team have minutes to save a truck driver’s severed leg. Drs Andrew Trezise and Emma West search for neck injuries on a cyclist who’s collided with a van. Then Nurse Eliza Burke notices a red flag. Drs Michael Conboy and Steve Pincus struggle to relocate a student’s jaw after he yawned. Dr Andrew Wallace and Nurse Chelsea Jones fear a champion horse rider might be paralysed after a hard fall.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: For 175 years, the Royal Melbourne Hospital has rescued people having their worst day. Doctor Scott Taylor fears a tradie has life-altering neck damage after a ladder fall. Nurse Susan Hartman keeps the man completely still, but soon his breathing fails. Doctor Jonathan Papson shares nicknames he’s earned at work, but it’s J-Paps medical skills that a power-boat racer needs after a spectacular high-speed crash. Nurse Practitioner Paul Casey needs help to reset a dislocated shoulder.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: It’s training day at the Royal Melbourne Hospital as Doctors Emma West and Jonathan Papson run new doctors through their paces with make-believe trauma patients. Playtime is soon over as Drs Jonathan and Emmanuel Karpathakis examine a cyclist with glass stuck in his neck. Any movement could be catastrophic. Dr Michelle Thornhill and Dr Martin Dutch struggle to get oxygen into a young mother having seizures. Dr Mya Cubitt uses her phone light to see where her young patient is bleeding from.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital’s Emergency department creates a puzzle for Dr Jonathan Papson: a teenage rugby player who received a hard tackle seems uninjured, so why is he struggling to breathe? Dr Terry Kane, who came to Australia on a whim, faces the worst trauma he’s dealt with. A motorcyclist has a broken pelvis and could bleed to death. Nurse Chelsea Jones also fears his forgetfulness might not be from painkillers but a brain bleed. Dr Steve Pinkus has shocking news for a heart patient.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At the Royal Melbourne Hospital’s emergency department, Doctors Jonathan Papson and Emma West’s friendly chat about peaches is quickly dropped as they treat a mechanic who could lose his crushed arm. Drs Michael Dunn and Mark Putland rally the team to save a truck driver who blacked out and smashed his semi-trailer into a tree. Dr Luke De La Rue’s decision not to ride his bike in the city is reinforced when treating a cyclist with a horrifically mangled ankle after being hit by a car.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Dr Andrew Trezise worries a young dirt bike rider has life-altering injuries after a crash. The rider rolled a truck only the week before. The phone doesn’t stop ringing for Nurse Gunnar Petersen as patients pour in. Dr Jonathan Papson examines a showjumper in agony with multiple breaks after being thrown off a horse. Dr Michael Dunne and Nurse Ebony-Lee Butterworth look for hidden injuries in a stoic tradie who has fallen 3 metres off a roof.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, Doctor Jonathan Papson arrives fresh from a family emergency after his daughter’s car broke down with his staff card in it. Moments later, he discovers devastating news for an injured ute driver. Dr Tsung Chung cuts short his favourite meal - peanut butter and jam sandwiches - to help a woman in agony after a high-speed crash. Drs Andrew Wallace and Emma West fear a chef, who fell down an escalator, has brain injuries. Otto wins hearts and cuddles in the office.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Trauma patients arrive day and night to The Royal Melbourne Hospital. The moment Dr Jonathan Papson hears ‘motorbike’, he prepares for multiple injuries and a world of pain for his next patient. Later, he’s impressed with a mechanic’s pain tolerance after he was crushed under a ute when the jack gave way. Dr Andrew Wallace shows off his ‘fugly’ shoes and colourful socks before seeing his next patient who has a punctured lung and broken pelvis from a bicycle crash.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Every eleven seconds a cry for help comes through to emergency services. Flight paramedic Steve heads to the country after a tractor topples over and crushes a farmer. Taz and new teammate Erika hope for the best and prepare for the worst as a much-loved grandma collapses at home. A woman having multiple seizures has Michaela and Simon on high alert. The mother of two’s life is in their hands as she can’t breathe for herself. Steve and Jade’s patient has severe pain, but what’s causing it?

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Alarm bells ring for Michaela, as a super-fit dad suddenly has slurred speech. Father-daughter team Brett and Teagan finally work together. They’re shocked by the deep gash on a woman’s leg after tumbling downstairs. Eamon and Mike are teaming up again, helping an elderly asthmatic man who can’t stop coughing. Veterans Doddsy and Andrew’s day is upended as they race to a motorcyclist crash victim with extensive injuries. A six-month-old baby gives Leonard and Cullen a huge scare.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Cam is confronted with carnage after a motorcyclist crashes into parked cars in a suburban street. The treatment Cam needs to perform could go horribly wrong, but without it, the patient will stop breathing. New partners Jodie and Nathan rush to an overheated triathlete who collapses over the finish line. Steve and the flight crew hold a rural GP’s life in their hands. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stoic 96-year-old is downplaying her symptoms as they look for signs of a ‘silent heart attack’.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Nicola and Risky have a quick catch up before it’s straight back to work, treating a disoriented driver who’s had a seizure and crashed her car. Mike and Eamon get all the red flags while treating a mother who’s having a stroke. Simon and Michaela work in cramped conditions, extracting an unconscious young man who’s collapsed at work and is unresponsive. Jodie and Nathan need police help to stay safe while tending an upset patient who’s putting himself and others in danger.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: In Victoria, a cry for help comes to emergency services every eleven seconds. Newly-minted MICA paramedic Leonard needs all his skills to help a karate student make it back from the brink of a cardiac arrest. Taz and Erika’s fragile patient starts to come good, then deteriorates fast in the ambulance. Flight paramedic Steve and the team respond to a horrific crash, where a single mum has gone off a bridge and landed into a river. Cam races to a young man with mysterious abdominal pain.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Simon and Michaela mentor a new paramedic in high-demand hands-on revival skills after a young man takes a heroin overdose. Mike and Eamon worry a teen could have life-changing head injuries after a fall and seizure at school. Nicola and Risky check an older driver for spinal fractures after a crash leaves him in agony, and he feels every bump on the way to hospital. Steve and Jade deliver essential care for an incredible woman whose deteriorating health is on a knife edge.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: An elite team is ready to save people having their worst day. Alarm bells ring for Cam and Doddsy after a healthy man collapses having multiple seizures. Jade is impressed with Steve’s skills as they support a scared patient who’s struggling to breathe with suspected Covid. Leonard and Cullen attempt a trick-move to stop a woman’s heart from racing. Tanie and Marlie suspect a stressed-out fraud victim could be having a heart attack.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Flight Paramedic Steve worries a teen motorbike rider could lose his leg, after a high-speed crash. MICA Matt faces a grim scenario, as a dearly loved great grandfather’s lung collapses. Taz and Erica are on high alert, when a drug-affected woman wanders onto the street. Father and daughter team Brett and Teagan have a gut-wrenching situation as a mother can’t wake her seven-year-old child. Mike and Eamon rush to a man who collapses in a pizza restaurant before his meal arrives.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: Steve and Jade carry a top range of painkillers, but their motorbike crash victim won’t take any. Traffic slows Simon and Michaela as they race to a heart attack survivor drifting in and out of consciousness. Single-responder Jodie’s chest-pain patient has an alarming medical history. Marlie and Tanie’s elderly patient is in agony from a fall and can’t explain what’s happened. Father-Daughter team Teagan and Brett are called to a potential heart attack, but their patient is only in his teens.

programme.title: Paramedics
programme.desc: MICA paramedics Nathan and Jodie patch up a dirtbike rider who’s fallen five metres and landed on his bum. A suburban shooting has Cam and Al battling to save a young man’s life. He’s in critical condition with an open chest wound. Risky and Nicola are super-impressed with a spritely but unsteady 92-year-old. A road accident has given a young driver some small cuts, and Mike and Eamon then check for deeper injuries. An elderly woman’s dizzy symptoms puzzle single-responder Andrew.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Emergency Department is non-stop 24/7. Dr Mark Putland examines what’s left of a limestone quarry worker’s arm after it was mangled in a machine. Dr Assiya Halid checks a man for broken and dislocated bones after he collided with a car on his way to a date. Dr Jonathan Papson works carefully to remove a screw from a man’s thumb after a home DIY mishap. Dr Luke de la Rue fears for an unborn baby after a 30-week pregnant mother was hit by a bus.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the experts are in England, Woburn Abbey in Bedfordshire. Treasured items brought to light include a rare washing bowl for beards, a portrait of a handsome cat valued at 18,000 pounds, and a Victorian bracelet that imitates a snake.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow UK
programme.desc: A Victorian multi-purpose penknife, a miniature theatre, and a Japanese lacquered chest of astonishing rarity and considerable value are among the treasures discovered on a visit to Clitheroe in Lancashire.
